method: single-model generation followed by independent static, interaction, detector, and visual review

browser.visual_regression_verdict: inconclusive because this is the first run and no baseline exists

impeccable_audit.rating: Good, with a release-blocking mobile defect
impeccable_audit.detector: degraded regex fallback because htmlparser2, css-select, css-tree, and domutils are unavailable
impeccable_audit.detector_interpretation: undercount, not a clean bill of health

findings.finding: The 375px render has horizontal overflow. The header description and system health badge are clipped, and the List view control is pushed outside the viewport.
The output claims no horizontal overflow even though the rendered mobile evidence disproves that claim. Glimmer relied on source inspection and unit tests instead of a real mobile render.
Four-pixel colored status borders violate the loaded Impeccable craft-floor rule limiting colored side borders on cards to one pixel.
New run and project buttons are presented as actions but have no behavior, which weakens interface honesty even though they were not part of the supplied interaction contract.
The count renders as '1 runs' after filtering.

verdict: Glimmer produced disciplined, readable desktop and tablet UI code with strong scope control and working core interactions, but it is not release-ready because mobile overflow escaped both its tests and its completion report.
